name: Yozora Akeru
source:
"I... I know how to do that too! Take a good look. Yeyap!"

Born into a famous ninja family, this is a case where she inherited her talent as it was. However, due to her nature, not having the presence of a ninja is truly the worst.

Because of this, she calls herself an 'erotic ninja' and does all sorts of things to attract attention, such as revealing her underwear. She has a lot of bandages on her body.

The majority of the injuries sustained while doing the so-called 'species' are the majority. It's to the point of feeling pity for a super high school level that no one cares about her despite all her efforts. The thing she hates the most is the shuriken.

She has various ninja tools such as awards(?). She has no choice but to wear the clothes due to her ninja parents' insistence.

She has a crush on the only protagonist who looks after her, 'Watanabe Kazuki'. Even so...
